name: Relationship Astrology Consultation
purpose: Two natal charts considered together to understand the relationship from both sides: where connection comes naturally, where the same interaction may feel different to each person, and where communication or needs can miss one another.
method: I use synastry to study the relationship between both natal charts, then we bring that symbolism into the relationship you are actually living. The useful question is not whether two charts receive a compatibility score; it is how the same dynamic may be experienced from two different internal perspectives, where affinity is easy to recognize, and where recurring friction can make more sense once both sides are visible.
bestFor: Any two people who want to understand a meaningful relationship more clearly: couples, partners, or another close pair
Seeing how the same interaction can be experienced differently by each person
Understanding recurring communication, care, security, or friction patterns with more context and less blame
notFor: A compatibility score or a verdict on whether to stay or go. The charts can describe dynamics; the decision remains yours
Reading someone's chart without their knowledge: both parties' presence is preferred
intakeRequirements: Birth date, exact time, and place for both people
The relationship context and your questions
includes: The interaction between both natal charts and the relationship patterns that stand out
Where each person may experience the same dynamic differently
Communication, care, security, affinity, and tension considered in the context of the real relationship
A clearer view of the dynamics you can work with together, without reducing either person to a score
preparation: Gather accurate birth data for both people. Ideally from birth certificates
Come together if you can; both parties' presence is preferred
